crossRefs.note: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay…
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you…
because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the…
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
“Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But I came to this time for this cause.
